name: tempmhacks
description: Repository scaffold and local development commands for tempMhacks

scripts.db:generate: mkdir -p packages/db-generated/src/generated && spacetime generate --lang typescript --out-dir packages/db-generated/src/generated --module-path spacetimedb
scripts.build:shared: npm run build --workspace @tempmhacks/db-generated && npm run build --workspace @tempmhacks/shared
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck --workspace @tempmhacks/spacetimedb
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && tsx --test apps/web/tests/*.test.ts spacetimedb/tests/*.test.ts services/cv/tests/*.test.ts services/photon/tests/*.test.ts services/alerts/tests/*.test.ts scripts/demo/*.test.ts
scripts.db:build: npm run typecheck && spacetime build --module-path spacetimedb
scripts.db:publish: npm run typecheck && spacetime publish --server local --module-path spacetimedb tempmhacks-local
scripts.db:publish:maincloud: npm run typecheck && spacetime publish --server maincloud --module-path spacetimedb $SPACETIMEDB_DATABASE
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @tempmhacks/web
scripts.dev:cv: node -e "console.log('Placeholder: implement computer vision development in services/cv/')"
scripts.dev:incident: node -e "console.log('Placeholder: implement incident development in services/incident/')"
scripts.demo:start: node -e "console.log('Hosted DB: set SPACETIMEDB_* in .env, then run npm run demo:seed:cameras:sdk and npm run dev:photon / npm run dev:alerts. Local DB: npm run demo:download-fixture, npm run db:publish, npm run demo:seed:cameras.')"
